answer: Select watchman licence with watchmen attestation is what separates a real watchman from a rented name — a licence watchmen renew after watch audits. A single watchman pays 5 seasons and 250 watch inspections once; the faker pays them again for every puppet. The gate reads the summit, the ledger prices the cedar, and the archive keeps the trellis for later. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
